capabilities.title: Write batches or a logical plan; distinguish staging from publication
capabilities.brief: Prefer WriteBuilder for a complete append/replacement operation. RecordBatchWriter provides staged file production with an explicit commit boundary. At this commit, Ignore on an existing WriteBuilder path appended rows in the retained probe.

choices.choose_when: An operation should write data and publish a Delta commit
choices.tradeoff: Builder consumes the table value and returns an updated DeltaTable
The supplied operation session must support Delta's custom planning nodes

choices.choose_when: You need incremental batch ingestion and explicit flush/publication control
choices.tradeoff: flush creates actions/files; flush_and_commit publishes them

unknowns: Exact file-size targets, throughput and memory/spill behavior require workload-specific measurement.

capabilities.title: Reason about optimistic commits and errors after publication
capabilities.brief: Separate data preparation, optimistic log publication and post-commit work. An operation error does not establish that the table is unchanged.

choices.choose_when: Built-in operation already captures the needed read/write semantics
choices.tradeoff: Customize metadata and retry policy without reproducing actions

choices.choose_when: You own valid protocol actions and their transactional meaning
choices.tradeoff: You must supply correct operation/read-set semantics and recovery

choices.choose_when: The failure may have occurred after log publication
choices.tradeoff: Observe table state before retrying data production

unknowns: Crash recovery, remote backend atomicity and distributed scheduling are not inferred from local-memory publication.

capabilities.title: Use kernel snapshots, scans and engine interfaces at the correct layer
capabilities.brief: Use high-level DeltaTable operations for normal table work. Use the kernel and engine interfaces when implementing a scan/engine boundary and when prepared to honor its selection, schema and protocol contracts.

choices.choose_when: The task is querying or mutating a Delta table
choices.tradeoff: Already integrates protocol, storage and DataFusion semantics

choices.choose_when: You are implementing engine evaluation/I/O or consuming kernel scan primitives
choices.tradeoff: Own the engine contract and apply selection/deletion semantics correctly

choices.choose_when: The supplied engine implementation fits the integration
choices.tradeoff: Keep its fork/feature/version identity aligned with delta-rs

unknowns: Custom engine correctness and every internal-api surface are unreviewed beyond the selected contracts; no complete custom engine implementation is certified.
